_what: LANE B METEOR: lane A's painted primitives as GROUND PLATES, worn by the painted surfaces' ground terms (PaintedWorld.with_fx). ONE RGBA PNG (named .bin: never imported, shipped as is): R = the ring's value index, G = its alpha; B = the burning ground's value index, A = its alpha. Each is its painting's content, square-cropped round its anchor (the ring: its box's centre; the burning ground: its dark puddle's centre, so its flames rise above the target) and resized to 512 px. The value planes map to the kit palette in the shader: < 0.25 rim, < 0.55 outer, < 0.87 mid, else core.
